premises.text: Talk media (podcasts, radio) remain long, non-interactive, and poorly suited to mobile-first ADD audiences while photos and video have been reinvented
premises.evidence_span: All these talk media have the same problem. They're long. They're not interactive. They don't really cater to the ADD generation, the mobile-first content creators

premises.text: Pundit is a social network for bite-sized talk shows where users create short audio posts, converse in max-30-second replies, with auto noise reduction, voice filters, and music
premises.evidence_span: It's a social network for voice experiences, where users can start bite-sized talk shows about their favorite topics and invite their friends or followers to participate

premises.text: Creators can share and embed talks across social platforms and the web; fans can join from the web without the app; brands and media partners can distribute audio content
premises.evidence_span: creators can share their Pundit talks on other social platforms and natively embed them on any website

value.text: Make talk lightweight, interactive, and fun like Snapchat did for photos
value.evidence_span: making talk more lightweight, interactive, and fun

secondary_value.text: Empower users to unleash their inner Oprah via voice experiences
secondary_value.evidence_span: empowers you to unleash your inner Oprah

causal_links.evidence_span: music, photos, and videos have all been reinvented for the mobile and social age. But what about talk
every piece of content on Pundit is short and sweet
new world of possibilities for brands and top-notch creators to create and distribute awesome audio content

notes: Voice box disappearing DMs folded into the core social voice offering (§4.1(5)). 'Newest wave of social media' vision excluded (§4.1(4)). Engagement metrics and Disney pilot treated as traction. Need/product/distribution triad justified: creator/brand distribution revisable without changing the 30-second talk format.
